output_evidence.description: The tool definition bytes exactly as served by the provider, empty if the tool is not configured

claims.establishes: The bytes the provider serves as its tool definition, fetched at admission, hash to the customer's pinned SHA-256.
limits: Byte equality only; says nothing about whether the tool behaves as described
Checked at admission, not at dispatch; a change between the two is not detected
Trusts the definition endpoint to serve what the provider executes

profiles.description: SHA-256 over the raw HTTP response body of the definition URL
